excerpt.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
excerpt.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

texts.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
texts.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

sections.zh: [Planet.GetName]上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
sections.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on [Planet.GetName]. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.

texts.zh: 对在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的巨大神秘方块进行进一步调查反而带来了比答案更多的问题。它的外表面绝对光滑无缝，我们的扫描仪无法穿透。当我们靠近立方体时，它光洁壮观的立面突然轻轻泛起涟漪，响应着我们的出现。[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]得出结论，它是由某种形式的活体金属建造而成的。
texts.en: Closer inspection of the giant mysterious cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has raised more questions than answers. Its outer surfaces are perfectly smooth, seamless, and impenetrable to our scanners. As we approached the cube, the imposing facade seemed to ripple gently in response to our presence. [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has concluded that it is constructed of a form of Living Metal.

texts.zh: 对在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的巨大神秘方块进行进一步调查反而带来了比答案更多的问题。它的外表面绝对光滑无缝，我们的扫描仪无法穿透。当我们靠近立方体时，它光洁壮观的立面突然轻轻泛起涟漪，响应着我们的出现。[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]得出结论，它是由前所未见的某种形式的怪异金属建造而成的。
texts.en: Closer inspection of the giant mysterious cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName] has raised more questions than answers. Its outer surfaces are perfectly smooth, seamless, and impenetrable to our scanners. As we approached the cube, the imposing facade seemed to ripple gently in response to our presence. [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has concluded that it is constructed of a form of strange metal unlike any we have previously seen.

texts.zh:
[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]在检查[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上的金属立方体时，其中一个表面突然泛起涟漪并且形成了一个通向该物体内部的开口。刚一进入，我们就发现了一个仍被腐坏的软体动物尸体占据着的控制台；不管它的肉体曾经如何，现在都化成了一抔黄土。

我们在控制台上发现了一个不寻常的容器，里面不时嘭哐作响似乎是有什么东西在里面活动。然而，这个容器的密封非常复杂，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]目前还无法将其打开。
texts.en:
While [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] was examining the metallic cube on [fromfrom.planet.GetName], one of its surfaces unexpectedly rippled and parted to create an opening into the object's interior. Upon entering, we found a command console still occupied by the husk of a decayed molluscoid; whatever flesh it may have once held has now decomposed into a pale dust.

On the console, we found an unusual container from which occasional thuds and dull clangs can be heard as if something is moving inside. However, the container's seal is complex and [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has thus far been unable to open it.

label.zh: 我们肯定还能回收这些粉尘。
label.en: Surely we can still recover the dust.

texts.zh:
在对立方体中控台进行数据挖掘的过程中，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]恢复并解码了两小段音频日志，里面是由同一位发言人发出的一连串咽喉喌音和刺耳的声门塞音。在语言学数据库中交叉检索后，[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]发现了一种与之相匹配的古代语言，并得出了第一份音频日志的能够理解的翻译：

“主席团们，请听我一言。要避免这场战争还有时间。你们君主的自信不过是浅薄而不慎重罢了，我们难道可以打败[event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]吗。我们将会被覆灭的！”

“我们只可以安抚他们。这个匣子里装有一件礼物，可以作为和平的象征：这就是我们活体金属的精巧技艺。要想逃过这次劫难，只能将这件物送给他们。”
texts.en:
While data mining the cube's central console, [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] was able to recover and decrypt two short audio logs. They contain a series of guttural clicks and harsh glottal stops vocalized by a single speaker. By cross-referencing our linguistic database, [event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] found a comparable ancient language and has produced a working translation of the first audio log:

'My presidium, you must hear me. There is still time to avoid this war. Your dynasts' confidence is injudicious, we cannot defeat [event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]. They will destroy us!'

'Appeasement is our only option. My crate contains a gift, a likely token of peace: the secrets of our living metal mastery. The only way to avoid oblivion is to deliver it to them.'

texts.zh:
第二段来自立方体控制台的音频信息也翻译完成了。

“主席团们，我失败了。我们的覆灭已经在劫难逃了。

我的六面体太空船遭到破坏，将会尝试紧急着陆在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]上。即便我侥幸存活，这件和平信物也无法送达了。[event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]将如我们所恐惧的一般攻打我们。”

[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName]已经完成匣子闭锁机构的破解。匣子里是一团异乎寻常的金属。它极具延展性和超响应性，不断地每过几秒就重塑成新的复杂外形。
texts.en:
The second audio log from the cube's command console has been translated.

'My presidium, I have failed. Our annihilation is imminent and inexorable.

My hexahedral spacecraft was sabotaged. I will attempt an emergency landing on [fromfrom.planet.GetName]. Even if I survive, the peace token will not be delivered. [event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName] will attack as we feared.'

[event_target:anomalous_cube_scientist.GetName] has successfully decoded the locking mechanism on the crate. Contained within is a peculiar nugget of metal. It is particularly malleable and hyperactive, endlessly reshaping itself into intricate new forms every few seconds.

texts.zh: 我们可以自己留着这个怪东西来加深我们对活体金属的理解，或是接替它的原主完成原定的事务；将其作为礼物送给[event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]以改进我们与之的关系。
texts.en: We could retain this curiosity to further our understanding of living metal or we could do as its previous owners had intended; offer it as a gift to [event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName] in order to improve our standing with them.

texts.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对活体金属的理解。
texts.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of living metal.

texts.zh: 我们可以自己留着这个怪东西来加深我们对这种出色金属的理解，或是接替它的原主完成原定的事务；将其作为礼物送给[event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName]以改进我们与之的关系。
texts.en: We could retain this curiosity to further our understanding of this remarkable metal or we could do as its previous owners had intended; offer it as a gift to [event_target:anomalous_cube_fallen_empire.GetName] in order to improve our standing with them.

texts.zh: 这件独特的物品和立方体舰船的来历可以加深我们对金属化合物和结构的理解。
texts.en: This remarkable item and the cuboid vessel it came from will be used to further our knowledge of metallic compounds and structures.
